Leaking 012 C and Leaking 019 C — ambientCG

Sources: https://ambientcg.com/a/Leaking012C and https://ambientcg.com/a/Leaking019C
License: CC0 1.0 Universal, verified 2026-11-05 at https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/
Downloads: https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Leaking012C_4K-PNG.zip and
https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Leaking019C_4K-PNG.zip

Only the unmodified 4096-pixel OpenGL normal and roughness maps from each set
are included. They supply different physical detail for vertical black runoff
and pooled floor residue. Original Blackweb generated alpha masks provide the
visible silhouette and color; these source materials were not described as blood.

Runtime imports are limited to 2048 pixels with mipmaps. Unused color, metalness,
height, DirectX duplicate normals, preview renders, authoring scenes and source
ZIPs are excluded from the game project and the dedicated-art byte count.
